notes: Gloss changed from the requested "persevere" to "prevail" per confirmation: both citations are the Jacob/Israel-naming narrative (Gen.32.29 "thou hast power with God and with men, and hast prevailed"; Hos.12.4, the same story retold) and read as "prevail"/"have power (as a prince)"/"contend" in every standard rendering, not endurance. BDB's related noun מִשְׂרָה likewise means "rule, dominion," not perseverance.
